name: American University in Dubai
englishBachelors: American-accredited degrees in business, engineering, architecture, communication, visual communication and interior design.
note: US-accredited (SACSCOC) and American in structure, with strong design and communication programmes and a central Dubai campus. Private and fee-paying; scholarships are tuition waivers rather than full funding.
summary: American-accredited university in Dubai Al Sufouh with 13 bachelor's degrees in architecture, design, business, communication, engineering and sciences.
about: AUD offers US-style degrees on a central Dubai campus; architecture is accredited by the US NAAB. Admission is assessed applicant by applicant, with attested school documents and English and maths evidence.

ib.text: AUD publishes no IB Diploma points or grade minimum; it says required averages vary by school system, so ask admissions. Engineering and Biology need school-level Maths and science standing.

noDeadline: No exact date published; fall applications run to July/August
notes: IB: the undergraduate admissions page names no IB Diploma or Course Results minimum and says required averages vary by school system. Ask admissions for the IB requirement for your programme; none is guessed here.

Entry steps: attested secondary transcript for the last three years, diploma, and a UAE Ministry of Education equivalency certificate (not needed for UAE MOE-curriculum schools). Documents are attested through the home-country ministries and UAE embassy or foreign ministry.

English proof: Academic IELTS 6.5, TOEFL iBT 79 or TOEFL ITP 550. Scores of IELTS 6, TOEFL iBT 68 or ITP 520 admit you with ENGL100 Developmental English; lower scores lead to the English Bridge programme, with no degree courses. Whether an IB English grade can replace the test is not stated.

Maths: an SAT Maths score (590 for Engineering and Biology, 560 for BBA, Architecture and others) or AUD's maths placement test. Students with IB or other advanced curriculum credit for maths or English may be exempt from placement; ask admissions to confirm for your IB subjects.

Engineering applicants need good standing in school Maths, Physics and one more science; the page gives grade cut-offs only for UAE MOE tracks (Elite 75%, Advanced 80%). Other systems, including IB, must ask admissions for the required grades. Biology asks for at least 70% in one science.

Architecture (B.Arch.) needs an online portfolio: three artworks with a short comment on each, and photos of three buildings with a 100-word reason for each. A decision follows within a week when the file is complete.

Dates: AUD gives only month ranges, not days: fall early applications up to March/April (priority for early course registration) and late applications through July/August. No 2027 deadline day is published; confirm with admissions.

Fees: tuition AED 53,025 per semester (AED 106,050 a year) for 12-16 credits, plus AED 1,000 per semester services and technology fee. The fee page does not state its academic year and says rates are reviewed annually, with recent rises of 4-5%. Same figures for all applicants.

Other costs: application fee AED 420; seat deposit AED 5,000, credited to tuition; optional residence visa and mandatory health insurance AED 8,200 first year; housing AED 17,000 a year shared or AED 28,000 single, plus a AED 1,000 deposit. B.Arch. students also need a laptop (about AED 4,000) and supplies (about AED 2,500 a year).

Scholarships: tuition waivers of 25%, 50% or 100% for the first year, kept if conditions are met. High school applicants for the Mohammed Bin Rashid scholarship need about 90% or equivalent; the IB equivalent is not published. The scholarship page gives no 2027 application day for undergraduates.

faculties.name: School of Architecture, Art and Design
faculties.line: B.Arch. needs an online portfolio; Interior Design and Visual Communication are four-year BFAs.

faculties.name: School of Business
faculties.line: BBA is the main undergraduate degree; Maths shown by SAT 560 or AUD's placement test.

faculties.name: School of Engineering
faculties.line: Civil, electrical, computer and mechanical; school Maths, Physics and one science needed, IB grades unpublished.

faculties.name: School of Arts and Sciences
faculties.line: Biology (a science at 70%+), Psychology and International Studies; a pre-medical pathway also exists.

faculties.name: Mohammed Bin Rashid School for Communication
faculties.line: Communication and Information Studies and Game Design; the BCIS has an Arabic track.

languageOfInstruction.note: AUD requires English proof (IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL iBT 79) for every undergraduate degree, but the pages reviewed do not state a teaching-language rule; the BCIS has an Arabic track.

admissionRoutes.text: No IB Diploma points or grade minimum is published; AUD assesses each applicant and says required averages vary by school system.
AUD publishes no rule for IB Course Results; ask admissions before applying.

programmes.name: Architecture
programmes.about: A five-year professional architecture degree with studio teaching and a 400-hour internship in an architectural office.
programmes.overview: The Bachelor of Architecture is a five-year programme of 166 credit hours. It includes a mandatory, credit-bearing internship of 400 hours over sixteen weeks in an architectural office. The programme is accredited by the National Architectural Accrediting Board of the United States.
programmes.ib: AUD publishes no IB points or grades; a portfolio is required. Ask admissions about Maths.
programmes.selectionNote: An online portfolio of three artworks and three buildings is required.
